hunks.before:
test -f "$native_fixture_root/dist/native-context-delivery.js"
          printf 'AUN_TEST_WASUREZU_ROOT=%s\n' "$native_fixture_root" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

hunks.after:
test -f "$native_fixture_root/dist/native-context-delivery.js"
          printf 'AUN_TEST_WASUREZU_ROOT=%s\n' "$native_fixture_root" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Verify six reproducibility cases in separate processes
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bun test tests/runtime-memory-ready.test.ts -t '^runtime memory-ready evidence gate SQLite dry-run reads a clean rollback-journal database without file or journal changes$' --timeout 30000 --reporter=junit --reporter-outfile=repro-sqlite.xml
          bun test tests/norm-022-runtime-endpoint-lease.test.ts -t '^NORM-022 frozen runtime endpoint lease fixtures healthy_endpoint_lease$' --timeout 30000 --reporter=junit --reporter-outfile=repro-norm-healthy.xml
          bun test tests/norm-022-runtime-endpoint-lease.test.ts -t '^NORM-022 frozen runtime endpoint lease fixtures multi_channel_single_runtime$' --timeout 30000 --reporter=junit --reporter-outfile=repro-norm-multi.xml
          bun test tests/contract/test_runtime_nonpersist_configuration_contract.test.ts -t '^AC-CFG-1 fresh hostname' --timeout 30000 --reporter=junit --reporter-outfile=repro-cfg1.xml
          bun test tests/contract/test_runtime_nonpersist_configuration_contract.test.ts -t '^AC-CFG-2 ordinary reconcile' --timeout 30000 --reporter=junit --reporter-outfile=repro-cfg2.xml
          bun test tests/contract/test_runtime_nonpersist_authority.test.ts -t '^NP04 valid UUID replay in a different actual process/workspace' --timeout 30000 --reporter=junit --reporter-outfile=repro-np04.xml
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import glob, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
          files=glob.glob('repro-*.xml')
          assert len(files)==6, files
          for file in files:
              cases=list(ET.parse(file).getroot().iter('testcase'))
              executed=[c for c in cases if not any(x.tag=='skipped' for x in c)]
              assert len(executed)==1, (file,len(executed))
              assert not any(x.tag in ('failure','error') for c in cases for x in c), file
          PY

      - name: Run full test suite
        run: bun test --timeout 30000 --reporter=junit --reporter-outfile=bounded-full.xml
